info.name: Admin APIs
info.description: Admin portal API endpoints for managing users and viewing system data. All endpoints require admin privileges (roleId = 17).

request.description: Login with admin credentials (roleId = 17). Token will have isAdmin: true flag.

query.description: Search by name, email, or phone

request.description: Search and filter users with advanced options.
Get detailed information about a specific user including role, organizations, and login history.

Update a user's status within a specific organisation (UserOrganisations table). This controls whether the user can access that particular organisation. Valid options: Active, Disabled, Invited, Expired.
Get login history for a specific user including timestamp and browser agent.
Admin-assisted resend invitation email. Only works for users with status Invited. organisationId is optional.
Admin-assisted password reset for any user. No OTP required. Password must be at least 8 characters.
Search organisations by name with pagination
Get detailed organisation information by ID
Search roles by name with pagination

item.name: Organisation Monitoring
Get Orgs Trials Expiring In X Days

query.description: Number of days to look ahead (default: 7)

request.description: Get organisations with trial subscriptions expiring in X days. Integrates with Stripe to check trial_end dates.
Get organisations with past_due or unpaid subscription status. Shows amount due and period end date.
Get organisations exceeding their subscription seat limit. Shows seat limit, active users, and overage count.
Get organisations grouped by subscription plan type. Without planType parameter, returns summary of all plans. With planType, returns filtered list.

item.description: Monitor organisations subscriptions, trials, and seat limits

item.name: Task Categories

request.description: Get all system task categories (parent categories only). System categories have organisationId = NULL and isDeleted = false.
Get a specific task category by ID with its subcategories and parent (if subcategory).
Get all subcategories for a specific parent category.
Create a new task category or subcategory. Set parentId to create a subcategory, or null for parent category. Name must be unique at the same level.
Update an existing task category. Only provided fields will be updated. Name must be unique at the same level.
Soft delete a task category (sets isDeleted = true). Cannot delete if category has tasks or subcategories assigned.

item.description: Manage system task categories and subcategories. Only shows categories where organisationId is NULL and isDeleted is false.

item.name: Default Priorities & Statuses

request.description: Get all default priorities. These are the master priorities that all organisations inherit.
Get all default statuses. These are the master statuses that all organisations inherit.
Create a new default priority. This will be available for all organisations to use.
Update a default priority. Changes cascade to ALL organisation priorities with the same key.
Create a new default status. This will be available for all organisations to use.
Update a default status. Changes cascade to ALL organisation statuses with the same key.

item.description: Manage default priorities and statuses that cascade to all organisations
